name: 14.1.Verify Page redirections for Showroom Landing Page
fullName: 14.1.Verify Page redirections for Showroom Landing Page
description:
Verify that the Showroom landing page (showrooms/) loads successfully and every in-page link (outside the shared header/footer nav) resolves without a 404 or 500 error, with correct trailing slashes on internal links.

Expected: The Showroom landing page should load successfully (HTTP 200) and every in-page link in scope should resolve to a valid destination — no broken (404) or server-error (500) links, and internal links should end with a trailing slash.
